questions.question: Who has achieved the fifty and 4 wickets in a match double more times, Marizanne Kapp or Lizelle Lee?
questions.explanation: Marizanne Kapp: 1 times. Lizelle Lee: 4 times.

questions.question: Who topped the runs charts in the 17/18 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade led with 207 runs, a joint record shared with Stacey Lackay.

questions.question: Which South African provincial union has a team playing in the Women's Japan Premier League?
questions.explanation: A result of the partnership between Titans Cricket Union and Japan Cricket Association.

questions.question: Which provincial union holds the record for 'Most Wins' (combined T20 + List A)?
At Newlands Stadium, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Leah Jones holds it with 19, a joint record shared with Nosipho Vezi.
